prompts: Original Japanese top-down pixel RPG asset visually inspired by Pokemon FireRed's overworld. Override generic no-text clause: real brand signage required. ONE isolated Tokyo DAISO variety shop, broad magenta pink fascia with correct large white DAISO wordmark and simple white brand mark on left. Broad simple grey flat roof visible from above, facade faces directly down, match attached reference sprites exactly in palette, outline weight, pixel density and three-quarter top-down angle. Logical 112×80 pixel asset, chunky pixels and minimal detail, wordmark must read at 1x. Generate at least 1024px, transparent background, no floor, no people or shadows outside footprint.
